content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission for the Project Engineer (Lithography) post at IIT Gandhinagar is 23 August 2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Engineer (Lithography) at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Engineer (Lithography) position in the latest recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Engineer (Lithography) recruitment at IIT Gandhinagar is online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Engineer (Lithography) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Engineer (Lithography) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. or M.Tech./M.S. with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience, along with very good academic records from graduation onwards.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) Recruitment 2026. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Project Engineer (Lithography) at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Engineer (Lithography) position involves initial application shortlisting based on eligibility criteria, followed by a selection test for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Project Engineer (Lithography) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Engineer (Lithography) position is Gandhinagar, Gujarat, at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website to apply and find more details about the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer (Lithography) Recruitment is https://www.iitgn.ac.in/. Candidates should visit this site for updates.

faq.answer: The employment for the Project Engineer (Lithography) position at IIT Gandhinagar is contractual, as specified in the official notification. Candidates should review the terms and conditions carefully.
